---
title: "Issue 14882 - brand font family names are quoted in revealjs CSS"
format: revealjs
brand:
  typography:
    base: Source Sans 3
    headings: Bricolage Grotesque 96pt
    monospace: M PLUS 1 Code
_quarto:
  tests:
    revealjs:
      ensureCssRegexMatches:
        - ['--r-main-font:\s*"Source Sans 3"', '--r-heading-font:\s*"Bricolage Grotesque 96pt"', '--r-code-font:\s*"M PLUS 1 Code"', '--mermaid-font-family:\s*"Source Sans 3"']
        # reveal.js' exposer.scss still writes the values unquoted first; an unquoted one after Quarto's quoted one would win
        - ['--r-main-font:\s*"Source Sans 3"[\s\S]*--r-main-font:\s*Source Sans 3', '--r-heading-font:\s*"Bricolage Grotesque 96pt"[\s\S]*--r-heading-font:\s*Bricolage Grotesque 96pt', '--r-code-font:\s*"M PLUS 1 Code"[\s\S]*--r-code-font:\s*M PLUS 1 Code']
---

Body text and `inline code`.
